findings.title: Teacher-name uniqueness is NOT case-insensitive for Greek: Greek capitals that look Latin are mapped but their lower-case forms are not (E/e, H/h, M/m, T/t, Y/y, B/b, Z/z, N/n), so case-only variants of a colleague's Greek name get a different key and are accepted
findings.evidence: Scanning every cased code point in Unicode with nameKey('ab'+upper+'cd') vs nameKey('ab'+lower+'cd') finds only Greek: Β/β Ε/ε Ζ/ζ Η/η Μ/μ Ν/ν Τ/τ Υ/υ (+ accented and polytonic forms, plus micro sign U+00B5), i.e. the most frequent letters of Greek names. No Cyrillic or Latin case pair is affected. Live (port 5302): teacher A 'Ελένη Παπαδοπούλου 779' -> 201; then 'ελένη παπαδοπούλου 779' -> 201 and 'ΕΛΕΝΗ ΠΑΠΑΔΟΠΟΥΛΟΥ 779' -> 201 (the identical Latin pair 'HELEN PAPADOPOULOS' / 'helen papadopoulos' -> 409 name_taken); a rename 'Βασίλης Αντωνίου' -> 'βασίλης αντωνίου' by a second teacher -> 200. Keys: nameKey('Ελένη')='eλεvη', nameKey('ελένη')='ελεvη', nameKey('ΕΛΕΝΗ')='eλenh'. The code comment ('Greek N / nu is the one place where the two cases do NOT look alike') and KNOWN_LIMITATIONS 'Round 12 notes' are wrong: eight letters behave like N/nu. Equivalence-relation/transitivity itself is intact (key equality); what is broken is the documented promise that case is folded, so a teacher can still take a colleague's Greek name by changing its case (the R12-A-01 attack, restricted to case variants).
findings.repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-A/greek.ts (key table + full-Unicode case scan) and /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-A/greek-live.mjs (needs a server on 5302): node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning greek.ts
findings.expected: sameName('Ελένη Παπαδοπούλου','ελένη παπαδοπούλου') and the ALL-CAPS form are true (409 name_taken), exactly as for Latin and Cyrillic names
findings.actual: Three teachers hold Ελένη / ελένη / ΕΛΕΝΗ Παπαδοπούλου; review labels differ only by case + (teacher #id)
findings.fix_hint: names.ts:25-38 / :85: fold case FIRST, then map through ONE lower-case table (so the table can never disagree with case): i.e. skeleton = lower(prepare(v)) then replace(LOWER_RE) with LOWER containing μ->m, τ->t, ε->e, η->h, β->b, ζ->z, υ->u (and drop CAPITAL entirely, or keep it only for letters whose lower case is unmapped AND add the lower case). For N/nu pick ONE target for both cases (e.g. both -> 'n' or leave both unfolded as the Greek letter) so that the relation stays case-insensitive. Add a test that loops over all cased code points (as greek.ts does) and asserts nameKey(upper)==nameKey(lower).

findings.title: The AI-hint answer guard is bypassed by invisible format characters and by whitespace/line-break variants of the correct option label; the guard only strips C0/C1 controls before checking
findings.evidence: Stub provider returning text containing the correct option label of hem-03-s2 ('Iron deficiency anemia'): exact label -> rejected (standard hint delivered); with C0/C1 controls or NUL inserted -> rejected (controls are stripped first, so that R12 hardening works). But 'Iron\u200B deficiency\u200B anemia' (ZWSP), 'Iron defi\u00ADciency anemia' (soft hyphen), 'Iron  deficiency  anemia' (double space), 'Iron\ndeficiency\nanemia' (newline: kept by the cleaner), 'Iron\u00A0deficiency anemia' (NBSP) and the reversed label wrapped in U+202E are all ACCEPTED, stored in hint_log.text and returned (source=assistant) -> the student receives the answer; the only thing a hostile or merely wrap-happy model has to do is to break the phrase with a space/newline. (Accent-stripped, Cyrillic-lookalike and fullwidth variants are accepted too.) hint_log.text == delivered == hintsGiven and the -15 penalty arithmetic were identical in all 40 fuzz cases, so this is purely a guard-strength finding; the docs already say 'verbatim only', hence P2 not P1.
findings.repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-A/hint1.ts (in-process app + stub provider, prints one line per case: leaks=true for labelZwsp, labelSoftHyphen, labelDoubleSpace, labelNewline, labelNbsp, labelRLO, labelRLOlevel): S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-1millnonstop-Downloads-escape-lab/d79a1deb-bec6-4b63-a442-e495d3f790d1/scratchpad/r13-A node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning hint1.ts
findings.expected: A hint that contains the correct option label modulo spacing, case, accents, zero-width/format characters or bidi reversal is rejected and replaced by the faculty hint
findings.actual: Delivered and persisted: 'It is Iron deficiency anemia.' (with NBSP / newline / ZWSP between words)
findings.fix_hint: assistant.ts:28-31: compare on a canonical form of BOTH sides: NFKC, remove \p{Cf}/\p{M}, collapse all \s+ to one space, lower-case, and also test the reverse string (so U+202E reversal is caught); in game.ts:725 also strip U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2060-2064, U+2066-2069, U+00AD, U+FEFF (and U+2028/2029) before storing, since a hint has no use for them.

findings.title: The Anthropic provider still measures the 400-character limit in UTF-16 units while Game.cleanAssistantHint counts code points (R12-A-05): a valid 300-emoji or 250-astral-Han hint is dropped by the real provider
findings.evidence: 300 x U+1F9EC (300 characters, 600 units) -> provider REJECTED, Game.cleanAssistantHint accepted; 250 x U+20000 same; 390 ASCII and 350 BMP Han accepted by both.
findings.expected: Same limit in both places (400 code points)
findings.actual: Provider rejects at 400 UTF-16 units, so emoji/astral-script hints silently fall back to the standard hint
findings.fix_hint: assistant.ts line 'text.length > MAX_ASSISTANT_HINT' -> '[...text].length > MAX_ASSISTANT_HINT' (or drop the check: Game enforces it for every provider).

findings.title: The reserved review suffix '(teacher #n)' can still be imitated with look-alike digits/sharp and an unclosed bracket, and U+061C (Arabic letter mark, a Bidi_Control) is not in the refused bidi list
findings.evidence: Register (all 201 on port 5302): 'Eve (teacher #1O)' (letter O for 0), 'Eve2 (teacher #l0)' (l for 1), 'Eve3 (teacher ♯10)' (U+266F), 'Eve6 (teacher #10' (no closing bracket), 'Eve13 (teacher No.10)'; refused (400): '#10', '№10', fullwidth, '[teacher #10]', ZWSP-split, Cyrillic 'теacher'. The stored review label would read 'Eve (teacher #1O) (teacher #77)'. 'Ab\u061Cc' is accepted as a teacher name (it is stripped from the key, so no uniqueness impact).
findings.expected: The digit class used by the check is also folded through the I/l/1/| and O/0 classes and the number sign through ♯/＃; an unclosed '(teacher #n' is refused or neutralised
findings.actual: A teacher can show a second suffix that reads like another account id; the true id is the LAST suffix
findings.fix_hint: names.ts:116-121: build the pattern on the key-style skeleton with LATIN_LOOKALIKES applied (so '#1O'/'#l0' contain digits) and accept [#♯＃№] and an optional missing closing bracket; add U+061C to BIDI_CONTROLS only if the product wants it. UI side: render reviewedBy with the last '(teacher #n)' emphasised.

findings.title: I/l/1/| merging (with i) locks out real, different first names: 4 of 1308 names in /usr/share/dict/propernames collapse onto another name (0.3%), and the examples are very common names
findings.evidence: Collision groups: Kari~Karl, Maria~Marla, Raif~Ralf, Tai~Tal; by the same rule Lisa~Ilsa, Ilan~Lian, Ilana~Liana, Lila~Ilia, Gail~Gall, Elle~Eile, Mario~Marlo, Daria~Darla, Li Na~Lina, 'Maria Lopez'~'Marla Lopez'. Registration answers 409 name_taken (correct status; the message mentions look-alike letters) so the user is told what to do, but gets no hint WHICH part clashes. Digits-only/'O0' names behave as documented (007~OO7~007). No empty-key or crash cases found: '', '.', '!!!', emoji-only, Arabic-Indic digits all produce non-empty distinct keys; 80-char names key in microseconds.
findings.expected: Documented (Ian~Lan, Ali~Ail) - reported only because the measured collateral includes top-10 first names
findings.actual: Teachers named Marla/Karl/Ilsa/Lian are refused when Maria/Kari/Lisa/Ilan exists
findings.fix_hint: Accepting this is a product decision; if not, split the 'i' from the I/l/1/| class and treat the l/I confusion only when the SAME string differs by case-class (not possible with one key), or restrict the class to names containing a digit/bar. At minimum mention the colliding existing-name length/initial in the 409 so the user can add a surname.

findings.area: be/src/db.ts:openDb busy_timeout=5000, tx(), Game.badges/expireStale (GET handlers that write)
findings.title: When another process holds the write lock for more than ~5 s every route that touches the DB answers 500 internal_error after 5-10 s (including POST /missions/{id}/start and plain GETs such as /dashboard, which take BEGIN IMMEDIATE in badges()/expireStale), with no 503/Retry-After and an error stack in the log
findings.evidence: Held BEGIN IMMEDIATE on the shared DB from a second process for 12 s: start -> 500, PUT /profile -> 500, GET /dashboard -> 500 (total 10.8 s), GET /me -> 200. No path returns 409 on start (verified in code: only 403 lab_locked/mission_locked, 404, 429), so the OpenAPI fix holds; but 500 is not declared for it. During 20 000 mixed requests over 3 processes sharing one DB (+ concurrent db:backup runs) there was no busy error.
findings.expected: A busy database is reported as 503 busy with Retry-After (or retried once) and GET routes do not need the write lock
findings.fix_hint: app.ts catch: map /database is locked|SQLITE_BUSY/ (errcode 5) to ApiError(503,'database_busy', ..., headers Retry-After: 1); game.ts badges()/expireStale: skip the write when nothing changed (read first, tx only when a badge is due).

findings.title: Start-up silently widens an operator-set read-only database (0444) to 0600, and chmods a database it then refuses (newer schema) after having switched it to WAL
findings.evidence: cp seed.db rofile.db; chmod 444 -> server starts, listens, and the file is 0600 afterwards; newer.db (user_version 99, mode 0644) -> exit 1 'Database schema v99 is newer than this build' but mode changed to 0600 and -wal/-shm created. All other bad-DB_PATH cases (directory, garbage, truncated, corrupt pages, parent is a file, unwritable parent, read-only directory, FIFO, empty string -> default path, relative path, path with spaces) end with one 'Escape Lab API cannot start: cannot use the database at <path>: <reason>' line and exit 1, no stack; HOST/PORT/secret cases also clean.
findings.expected: restrictFiles only narrows modes (never adds owner write) and nothing is touched before the schema check
findings.fix_hint: db.ts:288: skip the chmod when (mode & 0o200) === 0, and run the version check before PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL.

findings.title: Passwords are hashed as raw UTF-8: a password with an accent typed as NFC at registration but NFD at login (different OS/IME) is rejected with 401
findings.evidence: Register 'pässwörd-é-123' (NFC); login with the NFD form -> 401, NFC -> 200.
findings.expected: NFKC-normalise passwords on hash and verify (NIST 800-63B)
findings.fix_hint: auth.ts: password.normalize('NFKC') before scrypt (migrate by trying raw then normalised on login).

findings.category: cross-surface (frontend rendering of the R12-C-08 leaderboard contract)
findings.title: The documented backend contract is honoured, but the panel (a) prints 'Showing 21 of 25 ranked students.' for an UNRANKED viewer (me.rank = total+1) and (b) says 'The leaderboard is not available yet ... when your learning group is set up' for a viewer whose class exists but where nobody has XP (cohortAvailable=true, total=0)
findings.evidence: 30 students in one class, 25 with 180 XP: viewer without XP -> rows 20, total 25, me.rank 26, me.xp 0 -> describeBoard gives showMe=true, gap=true, count 'Showing 21 of 25 ranked students.' (shown = rows+1 <= total). Viewer in no class with XP -> total 0, me.rank 1 (rank > total never happens beyond total+1; normalizer accepts it). A class cohort with nobody yet at XP>0 or, for scope=week, nobody active this week -> total 0 -> kind 'unavailable'. Backend side verified: rank/ties competition ranking, rows <= 20, cohort=all, week window, rank recompute from roster XP = 0 mismatches, me.xp == /me xp, class-bound total identical for every viewer.
findings.expected: No 'N of M ranked' line for an unranked viewer; 'no ranking yet' wording when cohortAvailable is true and total is 0
findings.fix_hint: progression.ts:123-124: count only when board.me === null || board.me.rank <= board.total; unavailable only when !cohortAvailable (use a separate 'nobody ranked yet' view).

findings.title: Minor: (a) assertTeacherNameFree recomputes both keys for every teacher inside the write lock (5000 teachers = 236 ms per register/rename); (b) 409 class_name_taken carries no `details` while the other class rejections do; (c) classNameKey folds only with toLowerCase, so 'STRASSE 1' vs 'Straße 1', final-sigma and Cyrillic/Greek look-alike class names count as different; (d) a lone surrogate in a name is stored as U+FFFD (keys of stored and submitted strings agree for letters, so no uniqueness impact)
findings.evidence: perf.ts: 5000 x sameName = 236 ms; cls.mjs: class_name_taken has no details, 'Biоlogy 101' (Cyrillic о) accepted next to 'Biology 101'.
findings.expected: Compute the candidate key once, keep a key column or cache; give class_name_taken details {name}; fold class names with the same pipeline as person names
findings.fix_hint: game.ts:742-746 compute nameKey(name) once and compare with nameKey(r.name); game.ts:836 add details.

round12_fix_verification.R12-A-05 answer guard against dodging (c: PARTIAL (C0/C1 handled; format chars, NBSP, newlines, reversal not: R13-A-02)

notes: Environment: node v22.23.2; own servers 5301 (NODE_ENV=test+DEMO), 5302 (real limits, DEMO), 5303 (real limits, no demo), 5305-5307 (three processes on ONE db, raised limits), 5308 (db with legacy twins), 5309/5310 (TRUST_PROXY=1/2), 5341-5346 (six processes migrating v1 and v6 dbs at once), 5351/5352 (kill -9), 5321 (start-up failure cases); all on throwaway DBs under scratchpad/r13-A, be/data and be/openapi.json untouched, no repo file edited (a find for files newer than the start marker shows only another wave's report), openapi generated to scratch and byte-identical to be/openapi.json and to GET /api/openapi.json. All my servers were stopped by pid file. Baseline: npm test 184/184 pass (TMPDIR in scratch). HELD (could not break): (1) transitivity: key is a pure function of the stored/validated string, so 'reads the same' is an equivalence relation by construction; 40 parallel registers over 3 processes and 40 renames over 3 processes sharing one DB gave exactly one winner per key (the 2 winners in the first run were two different keys: my fixture 'Quiin'); 400 mixed concurrent register/rename operations over 3 processes and a 4000-op in-process random chain over a 60-atom confusable alphabet left 0 duplicate keys (dupkeys.ts); the demo teacher cannot take or be renamed into a colleague's key, 31 spellings of the reserved name (fullwidth, math bold, ZWSP, soft hyphen, braille blank, Hangul filler, Cyrillic/Greek lookalikes, I/l/1/0 swaps, trailing combining marks...) are 409 for register and rename, also after POST /demo/reset and while the demo teacher is renamed; roles are immutable (SQL trigger, no route), so no student->teacher path. (2) legacy twins: 5 twin rows inserted by SQL log in, rename inside their own key, cannot return after leaving (documented), demo twin keeps its name through POST /demo/reset. (3) bidi: U+202A-202E/2066-2069 are 400 for teacher/student register, rename and class names; LRM/RLM/ZWJ/ZWNJ names in Arabic/Hebrew/Indic/Persian accepted; names of only LRM/RLM/ZWJ/marks refused (400 'invalid format'). (4) hint cleaning: 40 stub-provider cases (ZWJ emoji, 400/401 code points, combining sequences, RTL, NUL, lone surrogates, C1, CRLF, U+2028, BOM, arrays/numbers/objects/String objects/undefined/2 MB text): hint_log.text == delivered == hintsGiven after reload, hintsUsed 1, penaltyXp -15 in every case, no truncation inside a sequence (limit rejects, never cuts). (5) OpenAPI: valid 3.1 structure (path params match templates, refs resolve, every response described), 29 operations x 11 token states (anon, student, other student, teacher, other teacher, forged, expired, ghost user, trailing segment, role lie, no-exp/string-sub) = 319 cells plus hostile paths/methods: every observed status is declared, 0 5xx; POST /missions/{id}/start has no 409 anywhere in the code. (6) start-up and backup: see R13-A-07; db:backup: exit 2 'Refusing to overwrite' for existing file/symlink/dir and for 3 of 4 simultaneous runs, empty or blank path -> usage exit 1, 0700 dirs / 0600 file under umask 022, quotes/spaces/relative/dangling-symlink OK, 8 backups taken while 12 writers hammered 3 processes (20 628 write rounds) all pass db:check, a held exclusive lock in rollback-journal mode waits then fails after 10 s with a clean message and leaves no partial file. (7) leaderboard: see R13-A-09. (8) route x role authz matrix (authz.mjs, 0 violations incl. other-class teacher 404, student 403 on teacher routes, teacher 403 on student routes, other student 404 on attempts); answer-leak scans (leak.mjs, leak2.mjs) over start/resume/wrong/hint/correct/result/lobby/vault/labs/profile/leaderboard/badges for hematology+microbiology and all exit codes through the Master Lab: 0 leaks, no banned field names; scoring oracle in-process with a fake clock, 324 random plays over 10 missions incl. caps, replays and XP totals: 0 mismatches; analytics vs roster vs student detail consistency for the 38-student class: 0 inconsistencies; content self-check (keys vs options/items/pairs, hint counts, fragments vs exit codes): 0 errors; state machine (parallel starts/answers/hints across processes, 6 parallel demo resets, reset during play) no 5xx and exact counters; kill -9 on two processes under load then db:check + counter/hint_log/xp_events/active-attempt invariants: 0 violations; migrations v1 and v6 -> v7 with six processes starting at once: all healthy, db:check clean, demo backfill flags exactly the seeded accounts (a real user on the demo domain stays 0); rate limits without NODE_ENV=test: write 60/min (429 with Retry-After), login 59-60 then 429, XFF rotation ignored without TRUST_PROXY, with TRUST_PROXY=1/2 rotating the left-hand entries does not help, a single rotating XFF against TRUST_PROXY=1 does (documented unsafe config); demo-off: demo login 401, /auth/demo and /demo/reset 404; 4000-request unicode/random-codepoint fuzz on register/rename/class/join/profile/roster-q/login: 0 5xx. Not testable here: read-only filesystem (EROFS), huge (GB) backup.
